claim_judgments.rationale: The claim accurately and completely captures both the satellite accumulation exemption allowances and quantity limits under paragraph (a), and the provision allowing compliance with this section in lieu of central accumulation area regulations except as specified in paragraphs (a)(7) and (8).
The claim accurately conveys the duty under § 262.15(a)(1) to immediately transfer hazardous waste from a leaking or damaged container to a good container or to a compliant central accumulation area.
The claim fully preserves the container compatibility duty set forth in § 262.15(a)(2).
The claim faithfully reflects § 262.15(a)(3)(i) prohibiting placing incompatible wastes or materials in the same container unless § 265.17(b) is complied with.
The claim accurately captures § 262.15(a)(3)(ii) prohibiting placement of hazardous waste into unwashed containers previously holding incompatible waste or material unless § 265.17(b) is satisfied.
The claim captures the requirement under § 262.15(a)(3)(iii) to separate or protect containers from nearby incompatible wastes or materials.

The claim accurately presents both the general rule that containers must be closed during accumulation and the explicit exceptions for adding, removing, or consolidating waste, and for temporary venting under specified circumstances.
The claim fully preserves the dual container marking and labeling requirements under § 262.15(a)(5), including marking with 'Hazardous Waste' and indicating the hazards of the contents.
The claim faithfully articulates the options available within three consecutive calendar days when accumulation thresholds are exceeded under § 262.15(a)(6)(i) and (ii).
The claim accurately specifies that during the three-consecutive-calendar-day period of excess accumulation, the generator must continue to comply with paragraphs (a)(1) through (5).
The claim accurately specifies the requirement to mark or label containers holding excess accumulation with the date the excess amount began accumulating.
The claim faithfully conveys § 262.15(a)(7) regarding preparedness, prevention, and emergency procedure standards for SQG satellite accumulation areas.
The claim faithfully conveys § 262.15(a)(8) regarding subpart M preparedness, prevention, and emergency procedure standards for LQG satellite accumulation areas.

unit_judgments.rationale: The accumulation permission and quantity limitations are completely covered by claim C0000.
The permission to comply with § 262.15 instead of central accumulation area conditions is completely covered by claim C0000.
The duty to immediately transfer waste from leaking or defective containers is fully captured in claim C0001.
The container compatibility condition is completely preserved in claim C0002.
The prohibition on placing incompatible wastes in the same container is fully captured in claim C0003.
The prohibition against placing hazardous waste into unwashed containers previously holding incompatible materials is fully preserved in claim C0004.
The separation and protection requirement for nearby incompatible containers is fully covered in claim C0005.
The closed container requirement and waste handling exceptions are covered in claim C0006.
The temporary venting exception to the closed container rule is fully covered in claim C0006.
The requirement to mark containers with 'Hazardous Waste' is fully captured in claim C0007.
The requirement to indicate the hazards of container contents is fully captured in claim C0007.
The alternative to comply with central accumulation area regulations within three consecutive calendar days when exceeding accumulation amounts is covered by claim C0008.
The alternative to remove excess hazardous waste within three consecutive calendar days to an authorized destination is covered by claim C0008.

The dual requirements during the three-calendar-day excess accumulation period—continued compliance with paragraphs (a)(1) through (5) and marking containers with the start date of excess accumulation—are jointly covered in claims C0009 and C0010.
The small quantity generator preparedness, prevention, and emergency procedure requirements are covered in claim C0011.
The large quantity generator subpart M preparedness, prevention, and emergency procedure requirements are covered in claim C0012.
